deploybot: :rotating_light: automated rollback initiated for prod-us-west-2 at 2026-03-20T15:18:10Z
- revert target: tag v2.14.1 (commit 9f3c2a1)
- reason: canary latency spike (p95 >= 1200ms), error rate increase on /generate route
- mode: staged unwind -> pin previous stable tag

morgan: confirming manual handoff off the auto-safety? i see auto triggered this morning.
jia: confirmed, auto-safety kicked at 15:17:52. i'm standing by to run health checks after the rollback.
rahul: i'll pause the canary router and mute traffic to the failing pool. tagging this as priority P1.
oncall: acked. switching incident channel to #incidents/prod-usw for broader ops updates.
morgan: before we flip, what's the exact revert command for deploy-runner?
jia: use the pinned deploy runner script:```./deploy-runner --env prod-us-west-2 --action revert --tag v2.14.1 --source=pin-lock```
rahul: running now. streaming logs to /var/logs/deploys/rollback-2334567890.log
deploybot: revert job started (job_id=rbk-2334567890). stepping down canary traffic to 0% -> 25% -> 100% on stable nodes.
morgan: putting a soft lock on autoscale to avoid flapping: `kubectl annotate ns inference autoscale-lock=true`
jia: health checks in progress: 1/5 services OK (embedding service still warming), expecting steady state in ~45s.
rahul: embedding warmed, kv-cache warmed on replicas. running synthetic prompt checks.
morgan: synthetic checks: generate 3 sequences -> latency p50 140ms, p95 310ms, errors 0/100. looks good.
oncall: marking rollback as in-progress in the incident board. please add short note on suspected root cause (kv cache regression) in the ticket.
jia: added note to INC-4521: "kv-cache regression after model swap caused request fanout and higher p95". also scheduled a postmortem triage for 16:00 PST.
deploybot: revert job completed successfully (job_id=rbk-2334567890, duration 1m24s). pinned service image -> v2.14.1.
rahul: re-enabling canary router gradually -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 5m.
morgan: can we hold a temporary block on auto-rollouts until the postmortem? set `rollout.policy=manual` for prod.
ja: done. `kubectl patch configmap rollout-config -p '{"data":{"policy":"manual"}}'`
oncall: incident board updated: rollback complete, monitoring for regressions for next 30m. tagging oncall for overlap. :thumbsup: 
morgan: thanks team. will follow up with release note and a pinned tag in the repo. closing thread once we verify 30m of stable metrics.
jia: will keep an eye on SLO dashboards, will post final checkin at +30m.
deploybot: final status: rollback finished, tag v2.14.1 pinned, redeploy of previous stable confirmed.
